result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers index rent and the price index to 2016 = 100 on one shared chart, which shows the gap between them, but neither gives the roughly 12% real increase or labels anything in 2016 dollars. B is cleaner: its title states the finding with numbers, it says outright that rent is not inflation-adjusted, and it labels both lines directly, though its small '2016: rent $1,180' label overlaps the line. A shows the same legend twice on top of its direct labels, crowds the 2024/2025 axis ticks, and its title is vaguer. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers index rent and the regional price index to 2016 = 100 on one line chart with direct end labels. Neither shows a series in 2016 dollars, and neither states the roughly 12% real increase, although both make the gap visible: A writes it out in its title as 15 points. A is better because its title gives the finding with specific numbers and it has no duplicate legend, while B adds two redundant detached legends, uses a vaguer title and has a dark theme that is poorly suited to a printed flyer.
